name: Container Health Monitor
description: Every five minutes, restarts containers that are unhealthy or repeatedly restarting and notifies the operator.

error_handler.title: Health scan failed
error_handler.body: Could not list container health states on docker-01

config.command: for c in $(docker ps -a --filter health=unhealthy --format '{{.Names}}'); do docker restart "$c"; done

error_handler.title: Container restart failed
error_handler.body: One or more unhealthy containers could not be restarted on docker-01

error_handler.title: Restart loop detected
error_handler.body: One or more containers are stuck in a restart loop on docker-01

config.title: Container health check
config.body: Container health sweep finished on docker-01
